recall.question: Five tapered bins are each 10 cm tall, and each extra nested bin adds 1 cm at the rim. How tall are they nested, against stacked separately?
recall.why: Tapered walls let the hollows share height: 10 + 4 × 1 = 14 cm. Stacked separately: 5 × 10 = 50 cm. Straight-sided solid boxes would not nest like this.
